method: Track symbol movement with alternating rules
steps: Slots TL,TR,ML,MM,MR,BL
Fig1->Fig2 and Fig3->Fig4 use the same movement (TL->ML, TR->BL, ML->MM, MM->TL, BL->TR, MR replaced)
Fig2->Fig3 rule: TL->TR, TR->BL, ML->MM, MM->MR, MR->ML, BL->TL
Apply to Fig4 (2,↑,D,7,S,X): TL X, TR 2, ML S, MM D, MR 7, BL ↑
A: middle row 7 S D wrong; B, C: arrow at top - eliminated
D fits
check_code:
# slots: TL,TR,ML,MM,MR,BL
f=[('2','D','0','X','5','^'),('X','^','2','0','7','D'),('D','X','7','2','0','^'),('2','^','D','7','S','X')]
def rule(a,b):  # b[i]=a[src[i]] ; None for new symbol
    return tuple(a.index(x) if x in a else None for x in b)
r1=rule(f[0],f[1]); r2=rule(f[1],f[2])
assert rule(f[2],f[3])==r1
nxt=tuple(f[3][i] for i in r2)
opts={'A':('X','2','7','S','D','^'),'B':('^','X','S','D','7','2'),'C':('^','X','7','S','D','2'),'D':('X','2','S','D','7','^')}
fit=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v==nxt]
assert fit==['D'], (nxt,fit)

method: Eliminate options for vertical mirror on the right
steps: Mirror at right of '5P6q7': order reverses and each character is laterally inverted: 7 q 6 P 5 -> mirrored 7, p, mirrored 6, mirrored P, mirrored 5
A: 7 appears rotated (L-shape), not mirrored - eliminated
C: P not inverted - eliminated
D: 5 not inverted - eliminated
B: all characters correctly inverted
Slots TL,TR,C,BL,BR
Each step: BL->TL, TL->TR, TR->C, BR->BL, C->BR
Apply to Fig4 (1,X,W,0,P): TL 0, TR 1, C X, BL P, BR W
B is Fig1; C has P in centre; D has W/P swapped - eliminated
A fits
check_code:
# slots: TL,TR,C,BL,BR
f=[('P','0','1','W','X'),('W','P','0','X','1'),('X','W','P','1','0'),('1','X','W','0','P')]
r=tuple(f[0].index(x) for x in f[1])
for a,b in zip(f,f[1:]): assert tuple(a[i] for i in r)==b
nxt=tuple(f[3][i] for i in r)
opts={'A':('0','1','X','P','W'),'B':('P','0','1','W','X'),'C':('0','1','P','W','X'),'D':('0','1','X','W','P')}
fit=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v==nxt]
assert fit==['A']

method: Complete the pattern using quadrant symmetry
steps: Diamond quadrants: left and right corners carry double lines, top and bottom corners carry a single line
Centre: double square frame with inner square crossed by both diagonals, continuing in every quadrant
Missing bottom-right quadrant: double lines at right corner, single line at bottom corner, frame corner with inner square diagonal
B: single line at right, double at bottom, no diagonal - eliminated
C: centre has single square, no diagonal - eliminated
D: single line at right corner and double at bottom - eliminated
A fits
